body: When I read this I thought that we were reusing our current SearchBox, turns out we do not but I understand why it's not the case. The current searchbox is only a vanilla JS widget (not an actual React component) that we made because we had weird use cases that we should not have tried to solve in the first place the way we did. `</LegacyRant>`
If only React gave props and state as parameter in `render()` so we do not have to put this boilerplate code in place and only do it destructuring arguments! Preact does that.
I actually never feel the struggle of repeating this.props., I like it it's descriptive about where did we find this data

This can be seen as a possible breaking change, I would make it only for the new template of search values (and so duplicate the template and provide a searchForFacetValues.templates.item). What do you think?
